description: Worktree test setup: state pnpm install --frozen-lockfile after each git worktree add in the git, worktrees, and delegate skills.

userStories.title: State the install step in the worktree procedures
userStories.description: As an agent, I want each worktree procedure to name the dependency install so that `pnpm test` and `pnpm run typecheck` pass in a new worktree.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/git/SKILL.md` § Worktrees states: after `git worktree add`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in the new worktree when the worktree has a `package.json`.
`.agro/skills/worktrees/SKILL.md` § CREATE — new branch and § CREATE — existing branch include the same install command after `git worktree add`.
`.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Waves step 3 tells the advisor to run the install in each worker worktree before dispatch.
In a new worktree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm test` exit 0.
